name: Arugula

schedule.notes: Succession every 2 weeks for steady supply.
Fall crop is sweeter and lasts longer.
Cut outer leaves at 3 to 4 in. Plant flowers fast in heat.

harvest.cues: Leaves 3 to 4 in long, bright green. Once flower stalk shows, leaves get hot and tough.
harvest.storageNotes: Fridge in airtight container with paper towel, 5 days max.

varieties.name: Wild Rocket
varieties.notes: Slower, deeply lobed, peppery. Perennial in mild zones.

notes: Bolts hot above 75 F. Use floating row cover to keep flea beetles off — they perforate leaves in days. Let some bolt for self-seeding.
